integrity.finite_checker_scope: Exact rational transitions, moment recurrence, critical identity, and numerical asymptotic diagnostics; analytic proof required for infinite limit.

scientific_limitations: Only the symmetric two-colour four-ball balanced replacement model, equal deterministic initial counts (2,2), and each fixed real critical-window parameter are proved.
No quantitative functional approximation rate or uniformity over unbounded critical-window parameters is claimed.
General fixed-parameter urn theorems are known; potential indirect implications of incompletely inspected older generalized-urn literature remain a priority risk.
Finite-state verification does not prove infinite-dimensional weak convergence. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: An Ornstein–Uhlenbeck critical window for a two-colour mixed urn
